title: Slopes Metric0 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=slopes:metric0
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for slopes metric0 data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate slopes metric0 events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you how your slopes metric0 activity added up each month instead of day by day.
